DJD.prior_source_exposure: Already inspected for cycle8; reused source, not newly independent evidence

layout_observations: DJD LXVI/LXVII and replicas show the target name row above the trough/numeral row and near the large lower-right loss. This supplies edition-based scaffold, not an original-preview letter registration.

UC15246571/UC15245667 cut18 center views show four adjacent arch signs with a boxlike pair to their right, above a lower-right edge loss. This is a candidate correspondence to columnX line14 and lower damage.
UC15245695/UC15246896 left rotations expose a narrower curved face, change apparent silhouette, and leave the neighboring Hebrew and name word division unauthenticated.

candidate_mapping.orientation: All displayed native; no validated cross-source geometric transform
reasons: The numeric/layout and lower-right-loss analogy provides a lead; a unique original neighboring-word reading or ordered defect crosswalk has not been secured.
The curved visible face and severe surface damage impede original row/word division; the handcopy and replica cannot substitute for observed original letters.

entry_results.prior_verdict_retained: Existing published-copy/radiograph check leans to cursive waw, not decisive; this attempt adds no original-letter vote.
surviving_readings: Siloam: cursive waw plus supplied genitive particle [[של]] and competing word division
Rachel: possible cursive resh and different word division
Jehu: edition alternative remains materially possible
publication_refs: Puech 2006 p.200 and pl.CCCLXXVII, CCCLI–CCCLII (existing plate_check record; not newly reinspected here)
